decisions.reason: This Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the initial all-caps treatment and its COMPLETE_WORDMARK and ALL_CAPS_WORDMARK scope.
The all-caps composition decision does not change the already approved capital Hero V geometry or any of its geometric attributes.
Selecting an all-caps complete wordmark does not alter the requirement that the É accent be copied literally from the approved Hero V terminal.
The source applies the established architectural vision to an all-caps wordmark but does not change the brand-expression goals or constraints.
The case decision leaves the unified terminal gesture and its application across the Hero V, second V, and É accent unchanged.
The source makes no decision about material treatment and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne-gold treatment.
The decision to construct the first complete wordmark in all caps necessarily establishes the case of the custom internal letterforms, and this Requirement has no matching message-133 Event.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Kenji,

Before work begins, I want to clarify the direction for the first complete VEILLVÉ wordmark: please continue initially with the all-caps treatment. My instinct is that all caps is the right first direction because of the architectural rhythm it creates, particularly with the hero V leading the word.

Another case treatment can certainly be explored if, after we have reviewed the complete wordmark, a compelling reason appears. Until then, it is important to see the architectural vision we have spent months developing come together as one complete identity.

That treatment emerged naturally during the process while the hero V was being developed; I realized, however, that I had never made a conscious decision about it. We have now established the architectural language, and applying it to the complete wordmark is exactly where I hoped we would go next. I am excited to see the system functioning as a whole.

I am really looking forward to the first VEILLVÉ wordmark.

value_updates.case_treatment: Construct the custom internal letterforms in all caps for the initial complete VEILLVÉ wordmark; another case treatment may be explored only if later review provides a compelling reason.

decisions.reason: Choosing an initial all-caps treatment does not alter the decision that the identity is wordmark-led and requires no separate icon or monogram.
